customers_say: Customers find the smart lock to be a best-in-class product with triple deadlocks for high security and multiple authentication methods. The installation process is simple, and customers appreciate its convenience for the whole family, with one noting it saves hassle searching for keys. The appearance adds a modern touch to the door, and customers like its features, with one highlighting the password masking functionality. While the overall experience is positive, some customers report a terrible experience with the app.

reviews.author: Sri
reviews.title: Excellent product and highly recommended!
reviews.body: This smart door lock has truly made our lives easier! We’ve been using it for the past few months, and it’s been a great experience. No more worrying about carrying or keeping track of keys. The remote unlocking feature is very convenient, and we also receive notifications with photos of visitors who ring the doorbell. It offers great convenience and peace of mind. Excellent product and highly recommended!
